utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive's getting some attention — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just help me keep the plan tidy — if you can sort the tools and tell me what’s still missing, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll sort the tools and make a quick list of what’s still missing. I’ll let you know once I’ve got it together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—just give me the quick rundown.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo. We’re collecting tools and spare parts for the repair drive—if you can bring what you’ve got, I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I'll bring whatever tools and spare parts I can find.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so, but I’d double-check the time and where to drop things off so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check the time and drop-off spot. Thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help out, just remind me what you still need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren. I still need a few tools and any spare screws you’ve got—whatever you can spare would help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got a screwdriver set and some extra screws I can bring by. I might need a nudge on the time, though—my memory’s not the best.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me what needs fixing and where the repair drive is happening? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I know it’s for a few things around the neighborhood; I should check the notice for the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — please check the notice and let me know the exact location and what’s being repaired. I’d like to be sure before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all — we’re just organizing donations and sorting out who can help with pickups. If you’re free, I could really use an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m free to help with pickups. Just tell me where and when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Just let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam. Could you help me round up a few extra tools and spread the word to the neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can gather a few extra tools and let the neighbors know. Just tell me where to drop everything off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t got the repair drive on my list yet—where did you last see it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I last saw it by the school office after pickup, I think. I’ll check with the kids’ teacher too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that helps—I’ll check by the school office first. Let me know what the teacher says.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already. If you’ve got anything to donate, now’d be a good time to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely—I’ll spread the word and bring something by too. It’s great to hear it’s already getting a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful of you, Quinn. Every little bit helps, and I’ll let folks know the drive could still use a few more donations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Rey, what exactly still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still checking, but I think the big things are a broken shelf, a loose door hinge, and a couple of lamps that need rewiring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—how many people do you think we need for those jobs?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can mention it around the neighborhood and remind folks about the repair drive. Let me know what details you want me to repeat.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik. Just tell folks it’s for the repair drive and to keep an eye out for the details—I’m still getting the updates myself.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do—I’ll tell folks it’s for the repair drive and to keep an eye out for the details. I’ll pass along updates as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m getting the repair drive organized for the block. Can you help me check who still needs tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help check, yes. I’ll ask around and let you know who still needs anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that would be a big help. If you hear of anyone missing tools or supplies, just send me their names and what they need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of support already—folks are really showing up. I’ll pass along anything new I hear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear, Tess. Please let me know if there’s anything I can do to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Eli—I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if they need hands, supplies, or anything else. Appreciate you asking!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries—you didn’t miss much, just that we’re still on for the repair drive and I’ve been telling folks to bring whatever tools they can. We’re mainly figuring out who can help when.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I'm in, and I can bring a basic tool kit if that helps. Just tell me when and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for asking. I could really use help with fixing the front gate if anyone’s available.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the front gate. When do you want to do it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit swamped, but I can help if you need me to bring something by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo. If you’re able, could you drop it off at the community center by 5?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can drop it off by 5 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m happy to help connect folks and spread the word for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. Could you share the date, time, and location for the repair drive so I can make sure I have the details right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I just need to check the final details before I share them, and I’ll send you the date, time, and location as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you bring any spare tools, tape, and batteries if you have them? Also, if you can, swing by around 6 so we can sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can bring some spare tools, tape, and batteries. I’ll swing by around 6.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you keeping an ear out. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — if I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo—I'm happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam—could you help sort the donated tools and set them out by the garage?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I'll sort the donated tools and set them out by the garage now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I need to know the timing and where to drop things off. If you share the details, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll send the timing and drop-off spot as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina — just let me know once you have the details and I’ll work it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, the repair drive is happening soon—want me to put your name down? I can also pass along the details to a few more neighbors if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please put my name down, and feel free to pass the details to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add your name and spread the word to a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I’ll need to work around the school pickup times. What part of the repair drive needs coordinating?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly the drop-off list and who’s bringing tools; I’m trying to keep it simple so it doesn’t turn into a whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That makes sense — I can help sort the drop-off list and I’ll work around pickup times. Just send me the tool list and I’ll see who can bring what.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I’m getting the repair drive organized and just wanted to check in with you. If you’re able to help or donate anything, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rosa, thanks for asking—I'm still getting my bearings, but I can spread the word and see if I can come up with something to donate.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, thank you, Nell. Even a little help spreading the word would make a big difference.
